objective: The home transaction list loads the next page while the loaded count is shorter than the total, and those loaded rows stay available to the figure detail sheet. When a home card query fails, the card stays on screen with a Try again control that asks the query to run again.
success_conditions: src/components/home/TransactionFeed.test.tsx proves the next page control appears while the scroll is shorter than the total, and a failed card keeps a Try again control that asks the query to run again.
The next page and the retry control are documented in docs/guide/Architecture.md.
